The '''''Gibbon''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Tector-class Star Destroyer|''Tector''-class Star Destroyer]] that fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The ship was one of a handful of vessels scheduled to do live-fire exercises before full production of the class was to begin. While stationed at [[Handooine/Legends|Handooine]], the ship was infected with a computer virus by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] saboteurs. At the [[Battle of Salvara]], the virus replicated itself and infected other ships in the task force, leading them to lower their shields when within range of the enemy. The battle was a disaster for the Republic and contributed to the stalling of the ''Tector''-class's formal deployment.
